jobs.name: 01-blue-blazer
jobs.prompt:
TARGETED TECHNICAL EDIT of the supplied animation sprite sheet. Return a single 1536x1024 image, same exact four columns by two rows and SAME EIGHT EXISTING CHARACTER POSES. This is not a redesign. Preserve the person's exact identity, face, hair, clothes, empty hands, full body, shoes, shallow round pale display bases, realistic miniature style, neutral lighting, and reading order. Do not add or remove any figure. No text, no grid, no borders.

Make exactly these three corrections:

1. REPLACE THE ENTIRE CHECKERBOARD BACKGROUND with a PERFECTLY FLAT solid CHROMA GREEN color RGB(0,255,0), hex #00FF00. Every pixel behind or between figures, every corner, and every gap between arms/legs must be plain vivid #00FF00. No checkerboard anywhere. No texture, vignette, gradients, seams, green scenery, background shadow or background glow. Do not recolor any character, clothes or base green. The output has an opaque green background intentionally. DO NOT attempt transparency; no alpha preview or checker patterns.

2. SCALE ALL EIGHT COMPLETE FIGURES AND THEIR BASES to exactly 85% of their current pixel scale, applying THE SAME 0.85 scale to every frame. Do not resize one pose differently. Center each figure/base in its same 384x512 cell. Keep the bottom of each base aligned at local y=485, and base center x=192. The invisible grid divides image at x=384,768,1152 and y=512. All body parts including raised fists must fit inside their own cell, with at least 35 pixels of clear pure-green margin above raised fists and at least 20 pixels below each base. Do not crop the figures. Do not scale down the raised poses more than the idle poses. Identical body height, identical base width and fixed foot/base anchor in every frame.

3. FIX THE RAISED ARM DIRECTION in the bottom-row arm-raising sequence. In bottom row columns 2, 3, 4, show the raising arm ON THE VIEWER'S LEFT of the body; the viewer-right arm must hang relaxed down. Because these characters are fully BACK-FACING, that raised viewer-left arm is their anatomical LEFT arm. Horizontally mirror ONLY the person and base in bottom row columns2,3,4 to move the raised fist from viewer-right to viewer-left. The bottom-right pose must have a closed fist raised straight overhead at viewer LEFT, right arm relaxed down, back of head fully visible. Preserve the existing stages: shoulder-height bent fist, above-head bent elbow/fist, fully raised overhead fist. No X marks on hands.

Do NOT horizontally mirror the TOP ROW or the bottom-left idle-back frame. Preserve all first five body angles exactly: front, front three-quarter nose viewer-right, profile nose viewer-right, rear three-quarter, straight back. The rotation direction must remain unchanged. Only flip the necessary raised-arm back-facing cutouts as described.

Precision sprite cleanup: solid #00FF00 background, all eight figures uniformly 15% smaller, same 4x2 layout, common base anchor, correct left fist sequence. No new pose, no new person, no new accessories. Save as C:/Users/usewr/AppData/Local/Temp/onoff-crew-gesture/01-blue-blazer-green.png if output destination is available.
